localization.promotional_text: Find memorable places, build your adventure list and keep your travel notes together. Explore classic experiences and optional one-time hidden-gem collections.
localization.description:
Make your next adventure one to remember.

Wayfinder helps you discover real places worth going, save the experiences that interest you and keep track of the ones you have completed. Browse more than 5,300 adventures around the world, with practical context about the experience, indicative costs and the best time to visit.

PLAN YOUR OWN WAY
Explore destinations by continent and country, save a shortlist and organise adventures into trips. Use Near me when you choose, or browse manually without sharing your location. Travel warnings remain visible, and destinations marked do not travel are excluded from automatic suggestions.

KEEP YOUR MEMORIES
Add notes, ratings and photos to your completed adventures. Photos stay inside Wayfinder on the phone where you add them; Wayfinder does not automatically upload or sync them. You can manually export a password-encrypted photo backup and import it into the same Wayfinder account on another phone. Sign in to the same account to access synced progress; photos move only when you deliberately transfer and import the backup files. Previously loaded catalogue content and phone-local memories remain available offline. Keep an independent copy of anything important.

DISCOVER HIDDEN GEMS
Classic adventures are included. Optional one-time purchases unlock hidden-gem guide collections for individual geographic packs or all continents together. The All continents collection also includes Antarctica. Purchases belong to your individual Wayfinder account.

Wayfinder provides discovery and planning information, not bookings. Travel, admission, permits, accommodation and guide fees are separate. Costs and opening or access information can change, so check current information with the relevant venue or authority before travelling.

An account is required. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data can remove phone-local memories that you have not exported.

Developed by RL Applications. Support: help.rlapplications@gmail.com

review_contact.notes: Wayfinder is a travel checklist and guide. Use the private verified review-account credentials supplied in App Review Information. Purchases unlock digital guide content, not travel or admission. The Me tab includes Restore purchases, Privacy, Support, and Delete my account and all my data. New photos are stored privately on the device and do not sync with progress. Near me requests foreground location only after it is selected; manual browsing is available. Use the hidden-gem store to test each non-consumable pack; All continents covers every geographic pack and Antarctica. Group and Community functionality must match the final review build and the additional test steps supplied with it. Do not submit these notes until all referenced features have passed their final live tests.
